author: Ari Koslow
title: Oneil Cruz (hand) resumes swinging
desc: Oneil Cruz has resumed swinging a bat.
impact: Cruz is expected to return at some point in July. He could be nearing a rehab assignment, potentially during or near the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryne Stanek leaves early Tuesday
desc: Ryne Stanek left Tuesday's game early against the Brewers with an apparent injury.
impact: Stanek appeared to twist his foot/ankle making a play at first base. He'll head to the clubhouse to be further evaluated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shea Langeliers (thumb) back in lineup Tuesday
desc: Shea Langeliers is back in the Athletics lineup on Tuesday against the Tigers.
impact: Langeliers suffered a left thumb contusion in Friday's game against the Marlins. He is back behind the plate and batting third.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Justin Topa signs minor league deal with Royals
desc: The Royals signed Justin Topa to a minor league deal.
impact: Topa will add pitching depth in the Royals organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alimber Santa recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Astros recalled Alimber Santa from Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Santa will add a fresh arm in the Astros bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mike Burrows optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Astros optioned Mike Burrows to Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Burrows was crushed by the Nationals in his latest start on Monday. Alimber Santa has been recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Konnor Griffin (finger) to go on IL, miss 8-10 weeks
desc: Pirates Director of sports medicine Todd Tomczyk said Konnor Griffin is going on the IL with an injury to his ring finger on his left hand.
impact: It is a brutal break for Griffin and the Pirates. He is expected to miss 8-10 weeks.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Jackson Jobe (elbow) to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Jackson Jobe is set to begin his rehab assignment on Tuesday at Single-A Lakeland.
impact: Jobe underwent Tommy John surgery last season and will now begin what is expected to be a lengthy rehab assignment. The right-hander has a 3.91 ERA and 41 strikeouts in 53 innings pitched at the MLB level in his career and will look to be an impact arm for Detroit down the stretch this season.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Cole Carrigg keeps raking in loss to Dodgers
desc: Cole Carrigg went 3-for-5 in a loss to the Dodgers with two doubles, three runs scored, and two RBI.
impact: Carrigg continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in two or more runs in four of his last five contests. The outfielder has rewarded manager Warren Schaeffer with one of the more dynamic options in the Rockies lineup, carrying a .978 OPS with four home runs, 21 RBI, 21 runs scored, and two stolen bases through 25 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ezequiel Tovar goes deep in loss to Dodgers
desc: Ezequiel Tovar went 1-for-3 in a loss to the Dodgers with a home run, two runs scored, two RBI, and one walk.
impact: Tovar has provided mixed results at the plate, collecting hits in six of his last 13 contests. The infielder remains one of the more underwhelming bats in the Rockies lineup to this point, batting .209 with eight home runs, 32 RBI, 31 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 86 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tyler Freeman chips in two hits, steal in loss to Dodgers
desc: Tyler Freeman went 2-for-3 in a loss to the Dodgers with one walk and one stolen base.
impact: Freeman continues a steady stretch at the plate, picking up hits in 11 of his last 18 contests. The outfielder offers manager Warren Schaeffer another stable option in a streaky Rockies lineup, batting .274 with three home runs, 23 RBI, six steals, and 26 runs scored through 61 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Freeland rocked early in no-decision
desc: Kyle Freeland allowed six earned runs on nine hits while striking out two over five innings in Monday's loss to the Dodgers.
impact: Freeland continues an underwhelming stretch on the mound, allowing three earned runs or more in 11 of his last 13 trips to the mound. The left-hander remains one of many dismal starting options in the Rockies rotation for manager Warren Schaeffer, posting a 7.46 ERA and 1.61 WHIP with a 2-7 record and 7.7 K/9 ratio across 16 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Heliot Ramos drives in five in rout of Blue Jays
desc: Heliot Ramos went 3-for-5 in a 10-1 win over the Blue Jays with two home runs, one triple, three runs scored, and five RBI.
impact: Ramos continues a dynamic stretch at the plate of late, recording hits in 13 of his last 16 contests. The outfielder has rewarded manager Tony Vitello as one of the more impactful bats in an inconsistent Giants lineup, carrying an .806 OPS with eight home runs, 28 RBI, and 27 runs scored across 52 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Luis Arraez swipes base in rout of Blue Jays
desc: Luis Arraez went 1-for-4 in a win over the Blue Jays with one stolen base.
impact: Arraez continues an impactful stretch at the plate, collecting hits in 11 of his last 13 contests. The infielder remains one of the few consistent options in the Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, slashing .325 with four home runs, seven steals, 33 RBI, and 45 runs scored across 85 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ranger Suarez (adductor) hopeful to avoid IL stint
desc: The Red Sox remain hopeful Ranger Suarez can avoid an IL stint.
impact: Boston is expected to see how Suarez feels on Tuesday. There should be an update on him later in the week.
